steps.content: You return to the lake where you said goodbye to her.
The Black Ring has been destroyed, but the contamination lingers. The taintless phantoms are gone, so are the shifting mist, the glints of light on the water, and the graceful dancer in white.
But under the surface, pinpoints of blue light swirl.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Who is down there? There is a source of power in the lake, very strong and... very twisted.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is it her?
Hella tries to jump in the lake, only to be hit by something solid. The lake surface, like a colossal mirror, blocks the entry of anything and anyone.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Abnormality detected! Distorted dimension! It's Mania! Focus fire on the target!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It won't work. Firepower doesn't work on her.

steps.content: You step onto the lake surface, walk to the center where she once danced, and take out the pendant the old man gave you, your shackles burning red glow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles didn't point me in the wrong direction. I should've known you're here sooner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I came to see you, Hamel.
You let go of the pendant, which is wrapped up in red light. It falls onto and cracks open the lake surface.
Icy water sucks you in and engulfs you whole, blocking out the voices calling you from above.

You're besieged by frenzied bubbles, on the verge of losing consciousness. But the prickly icy water wakes you up. You see faint blue glows, but below you is a bottomless abyss of darkness, from which rises a loud din.

steps.speaker: Greedy Woman
steps.content: Did you see something strange again? Don't say anything about it... There's a large crowd of reporters outside. You must present yourself as a great dancer, not some lunatic...

steps.speaker: Greedy Woman
steps.content: Keep quiet, and let me do the talking. All you have to do is dance. You'll become a legend... Just dance, and you can change your fate...

steps.speaker: Greedy Woman
steps.content: Dance for me, my child, my beloved Dancer...

steps.speaker: Dissatisfied Noise
steps.content: She's no legendary dancer, this isn't art for charity... She's nothing more than a lunatic, her audience are lunatics too!

steps.speaker: Dissatisfied Noise
steps.content: She is a demon... a plaything of the rich!

steps.speaker: Arrogant Man
steps.content: You took my money. Now, dance for me, Dancer of the DisCity!

steps.speaker: Haughty Man
steps.content: Don't you defy me. Now, dance for me, dancer of the DisCity!

steps.speaker: Rowdy Cacophony
steps.content: Dance! Why are you not dancing? I've given you the best stage there is. You must dance for us, Dancer!!
Don't go on stage anymore! Leave with me!
You're going mad. You have to stop dancing. It's for your own good... Don't you get it?!

steps.speaker: Twisted Voice
steps.content: He came to the carnival, because you caused him pain. Isn't that so? I comforted him, he's mine now. I'm not giving him to you!

steps.speaker: Twisted Voice
steps.content: Or... Do you want to keep me company? You're different from them all. You're strong, you're beautiful, and you're all alone too... You're more like me! We're the same!

steps.speaker: Twisted Voice
steps.content: <size=44>Love me! Love me the way you've loved him!</size>
Don't go, don't leave me... Come back, Hamel!

Ten meters, twenty meters... You're sinking. You're confined in the depths of the water, and your thoughts are spinning out of control, overwhelming you. But it's all just an illusion! You know you're almost there, for darkness is swimming up fast to greet you...
Who's that... Who's there... disturbing the Dancer...? Who's... trying to take the Dancer...?
Don't you dare take our Dancer!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get out of my way!

Your shackles drive out the darkness surrounding you. Your field of vision clears up. Countless tentacles reach up from the bottom of the lake, all tangled up. The entire lake is contaminated by Mania and has become a massive abyss of death.
Hamel is down there. Contamination tangles in her long hair and tears at her once-graceful dance dress. Darkness fetters the limbs of the Dancer, as well as her soul.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Wake up, Hamel!
Contamination has crept onto her face. Mania has been accumulating for 23 years here. Getting close to the lake bottom is enough to make your all sensations burn violently.
Hamel is entombed in this sea of Mania alone, as if she is in a deep sleep from which she can not wake up.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Wake up! I'm taking you back!
options: Wake up! I'm taking you back!

steps.content: Despite the pain, you walk into the cloud of Mania surrounding Hamel and touch her soul. Clenching your teeth, you use the shackles on her, hoping it can help her resist the encroachment of Mania.
You have successfully used the shackles on her, but she doesn't wake up.
Instead, innumerable hollow, wild eyes light up in the mud amid darkness. The abyss of death shudders.
It's the battered dolls that you saw rotting in the carnival!

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Been woken... Been woken... Have to face this place again...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=28><i>So lonely... So much pain... So scared... The explosion hasn't ended... Hamel... Hamel... We need Hamel...</size>

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Don't take her away from us... Don't take her away from us!

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Don't desert us! Don't leave us in this abyss!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If the real Hamel didn't get inside the Black Ring until after it had appeared, then who provided the mental contamination needed to initiate the BR-001?

You've seen this before, have seen such a display of craziness. In the abyss of the unclaimed crypt, the inheritance, screaming and howling, consumed countless maniac gangsters to aid its own awakening and revival.
Then it finally comes to you that what a Corpus needs is not a Sinner per se. What it really needs is pure darkness, the vast craziness of people.
It comes from deranged Sinners, bloodthirsty gangsters, or specters that can't let the past go.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: She's our Dancer! Don't you dare take her away!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's you who awakened the Corpus, you trapped her!
